claims.claim: The all-word-unipotent rational sector has the four-way full finite-state CCRA characterization.
Minimal-sector recognition and sector CCRA membership have polynomial bit complexity.
Explicit pattern sums have polynomial-size synthesis with at most sum |p| registers or NO words of length at most 2D.
Position sum satisfies the uniform condition but has no full finite-state rational polynomial CCRA.
MPS26 Theorem 15 and Section 3.2 state the necessary condition, insufficiency conjecture and Example 26 witness.
Position-sum pumping calculation is prior work, Example 26 and Appendix B.4.
MR19 Proposition 3 and Lemma 5 assume a non-zero semiring, unavailable over arbitrary signed rationals.
PS24 Theorem 3.4, Corollary 3.5 and Proposition 9.4 concern invertible representations and monomial/block triangular covers.
C25 Introduction recalls PTIME rational-series commutativity via minimal matrices; Theorem 1 treats effective prevarieties.
C26 classifies bilinear associative commutative series products and gives equivalence decidability for corresponding polynomial automata.
BLR24 concerns linear and affine CRA minimization, a different restriction.
R-generable EPS definition and characteristic-zero coefficient sums match source Definition 11 and Theorem 15.
Minimal subquotient is preserved through a polynomial minimum-rank projection, with commuting translation factors and algebra-preserving return blocks.
Every cited bibliographic author/title/year/venue/identifier record is as printed in references.
